title: EL vs scalar-reward RL at 1.5B: a matched downscaled reproduction
description: In 64 matched runs, scalar-reward GRPO outperformed experiential-learning distillation on held-out and OOD prompts (9 paired seeds, robust to LR and training length), while the paper's low-bandwidth prediction held: 3.3-bit quantized feedback produced no held-out gain.
